steps.name: Run backlog-hygiene check
steps.run:
# pipefail so rc reflects the checker, not tee
set +e
set -o pipefail
bin/check-backlog-hygiene.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/report.txt
rc=$?
set -e
last="$(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' /tmp/report.txt | tail -1 || true)"
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$last" = "backlog-hygiene: OK (0 findings)" ]; then
  has=false
else
  has=true
fi
echo "has_findings=$has" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Manage report issue
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# The report issue carries hygiene-exempt so the checker never
# flags its own report (no milestone/workstream by design).
existing="$(gh issue list \
  --repo dmfdeploy/dmfdeploy \
  --search "Backlog hygiene report in:title" \
  --state open \
  --label component:cross-repo \
  --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)"

# An incomplete or crashed run keeps the issue open and says so,
# because its findings list may be missing checks.
last="$(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' /tmp/report.txt | tail -1 || true)"
{
  printf '## Backlog hygiene report — %s\n\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  case "$last" in
    "backlog-hygiene: INCOMPLETE"*)
      printf '**The run was incomplete:** at least one check could not read its input (see SKIPPED below), so findings may be missing.\n\n' ;;
    "backlog-hygiene: "*) ;;
    *)
      printf '**The run did not finish:** the checker printed no summary line.\n\n' ;;
  esac
  printf '```\n'
  cat /tmp/report.txt
  printf '```\n'
} > /tmp/body.md

if [ "${HAS_FINDINGS:-true}" = "true" ]; then
  if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
    gh issue edit "$existing" \
      --repo dmfdeploy/dmfdeploy \
      --body-file /tmp/body.md
    echo "Updated report issue #$existing"
  else
    gh issue create \
      --repo dmfdeploy/dmfdeploy \
      --title "Backlog hygiene report" \
      --label component:cross-repo \
      --label hygiene-exempt \
      --body-file /tmp/body.md
    echo "Created report issue"
  fi
else
  if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
    gh issue close "$existing" \
      --repo dmfdeploy/dmfdeploy \
      --comment "Clean run — no findings." \
      --reason completed
    echo "Closed report issue #$existing (clean run)"
  else
    echo "No findings, no open report issue — nothing to do"
  fi
fi

steps.name: Fail on findings
steps.run:
if [ "${HAS_FINDINGS:-}" != "false" ]; then
  echo "::error::backlog-hygiene found drift or did not finish; see the report issue"
  exit 1
fi
